recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-30577; any remaining work should proceed in the IG Publisher/OpenAPI tooling issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking whether servers supporting search must support POST-based _search endpoints, including in IG contexts such as US Core, and asking OpenAPI/Swagger tooling to emit _search endpoints when CapabilityStatement search support is declared.
initial_application: No source-changing commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-30577 was found. FHIR-I 2021-03-22 minutes record the decision as Search via POST is required and identify the residual concern as tooling. Later R5 search-method commits and already-published reconcile commits for FHIR-36126, FHIR-35859, FHIR-38994, FHIR-39137, FHIR-31943, and FHIR-31944 applied or audited the current GET/POST plus 405 model and POST _search endpoint documentation.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the original US Core ambiguity and subsequent clarification that POST _search is mandatory. FHIR-40641 later resolved no-change for US Core because its guide already states POST search is required, and HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#649 remains open for OpenAPI _search generation. Searches found no in-scope OpenAPI/Swagger generator source in this FHIR checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active REST (HTTP) page already states GET and POST support, permits 405 for one method but not both, shows POST _search forms for system/type/compartment search, and includes POST rows in the interaction summary table.
